title: Why Google is giving software makers less time to fix bugs
description:
Google's Project Zero will publish bug details after 30 days by 2028, saying AI lets attackers rebuild a flaw from its fix almost at once.

In the headlines (TCR #283):
- Google's Project Zero cuts bug deadlines to 30 days by 2028; White House panel offers 12 months of relief
- Claude Code, given the open Alexandria crystal database, finds an unreported sulfide and plans its test

- Italy fines Meta €805 million over a Facebook gallery default that reached about 20 million users
